techniques.title: An implant technique for every case

immediate.name: Immediate placement
immediate.text: The implant goes in right after the tooth is removed, saving months of waiting when the bone allows it.

guided.name: Guided 3D surgery
guided.text: A printed guide places each implant exactly where the plan on screen says, with the smallest possible opening.

allon4.name: All-on-4
allon4.text: A whole jaw rests on four implants placed at angles, so a fixed bridge can be fitted within a day.

zygomatic.name: Zygomatic implants
zygomatic.text: For very thin upper bone: long implants anchor in the cheekbone, often avoiding a bone graft.

best.title: When a full restoration is the best solution
best.p1: Most of your teeth are missing, loose, or failing.
best.p2: Your denture slips, hurts, or limits what you can eat.
best.p3: You want one fixed solution instead of many separate repairs.
best.p4: Your jaw bone has shrunk and other clinics said no.
